description: Explicit opt-in only. Use an opaque context identifier; do not include prompts, transcripts, secrets or free-form reasons. Rows must have unique skill names. The agent must match --agent. The reader also enforces byte limits, safe paths and valid timestamps. States are independent user reports, not proof of current task availability, precedence, invocation or freshness.
